#0 chosen jewel — deep jade night (the celestial image-world); the choice staged twice: Indra's naming gives way to SW (the exact direction attention begins) and the pale jewel disc turns gold and grows (the selection itself); attract/pulse — attention choosing; auto-net LFO on circulation (the net's slow shimmer).

#1 recursive entry — ring layout: this jewel holding the others around it; ? → ! — the interlocutor's press becoming the contemplation's reply, staged as the sign's own turn; vortex/pulse — the entry that turns without leaving; bodies split at the two questions.

#1b ink dot — ∅ placed on the southwest jewel, then appearing smaller and dimmer through the field's reflections (centre, then afar) — no journey, no marking of every jewel; attract/implode — the mark gathers the field to it; the source span (T45 no. 1867, 513a20–513c16) kept in the body with the paraphrase guard.

#2 simile's limit — grid layout: two green jewel SUBSTANCES held apart while the gold ring (their images) spans between them and returns dimmed — the images enter, the substances remain separate, exactly the source's own restriction; 卍 → C24 (the refused fusion named, red, at the rim); repel/shove — the substances hold apart; the longest mid beat (14) — the qualification is held, not passed over.

#3 native relation — line layout: 0 and 1 held at the ends, (0/1)/(1/0) walking to 1/0 at All's station (Mono's return orientation); vortex/pulse faint — the reciprocal offices turning; auto-ones LFO on speed.

#4 account — spiral layout: the account winding around its source; Λ → C38 (the account's reference office made precise); the dark disc (the mark's consequence) brightens gold at the rim — re-entry staged as the account's effects returning as conditions; attract/pulse firmer — committed reliance.

#5→0 return — THE 3D SCENE. z is the recursion's depth: the returned jewel nearest (z +0.3, its brightness breathing — brightness depending on the others), the net rings at z 0, the commons square at z +0.15, and the retained mark deepest (z −0.35) where ∅ returns bright — the ending re-entering #1b's sign; pointer attract/implode — the return gathering to the jewel whose brightness depends on the others; auto-return LFO on pointerStrength.

ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0 began with a choice (Indra → SW; the jewel turning gold) under gentle attract — attention finding an exact place; #5→0 returns to that jewel with its brightness breathing and the ink dot (∅) from #1b now bright at the deepest station — the chosen jewel can no longer be understood apart from the relations its brightness makes visible; the simile's limit staged at #2 (substances apart) still stands at return (the source's final qualification prevents possessing the teaching through a completed optical picture). The Offered band untouched: M46 sovereign commons and the double-net comparison remain Offered; no prevalence or institutional effect claimed from the reflected mark.

Human-amplified guards carried (frontmatter: declared relations yes; new source-boundary application no): the essay's C24 criterion is not a substitution for Huayan's own account; apoha/dependent-arising/saṃkalpa retain their objects; the jewel cannot establish consciousness by being reflective; no eight ancient jewels manufactured; 2+2²=6 native, not discovered in the treatise; Cleary's wording uncollated; no common historical descent or physical-signal account. Mythemic verbs only: the net displays recursive mutual inclusion; the ink dot demonstrates a return made inspectable.

Automation: auto-net (the shimmer), auto-ones (the reciprocal offices), auto-return (brightness answerable) — tied to the record's moves; #1b and #2 held without automation (the mark and the qualification are held). Durations 11–15, transitions 1.2–2.0; the return held longest.
